prompt:
Design one NEW full-body female forest elf customer sprite for a cozy small pixel-art potion shop. Use the attached comparison board ONLY as a reference for the coarse pixel density, five-color material language and the small childlike body proportions; redesign the elf (second character on that board) as a distinct recognizable whole character. Do not copy the generic short brown bob. Single character, transparent background, no text, no panels, no shadow, no bottle or prop, no weapon.

Distinctive identity: a calm, cute forest herb collector. Chestnut hair with a clean diagonally swept fringe, a single chunky SIDE BRAID on the viewer's RIGHT, made of only two or three broad angular lobes and ending near the waist. Keep a short pointed hair tuft on the opposite side. Two long tapered elf ears read clearly on both sides. A bold simple two-leaf hair clip at the viewer's LEFT temple uses the same two green colors as the clothes. Rounded cheeks, a short tapered chin; a soft friendly chibi face, neither a rectangular skin block nor realistic. Two visible equal dark dot eyes at exactly the same height; no eyelashes, no eyebrows, no mouth needed, no eye overlapped by hair. Do not make her face smaller than the reference.

Outfit: a SHORT asymmetrical leaf shoulder wrap slants across the upper chest, with one light leaf-shaped panel, over a narrow sage-green fitted tunic, a small cream collar and short sleeves. Slim straight tunic hem, not a flaring skirt; exposed small knees and simple dark ankle boots. One relaxed hand by each side. The braid and leaf wrap should be identifiable at native sprite size; prioritize three big identifying shapes over tiny detail. No apron pocket, belt buckle, jewelry, textures or random speckles.

Exact production proportions: imagine a native 32 pixel wide by 48 pixel tall transparent sprite frame, enlarged by a common INTEGER factor for this image. All forms are snapped to the same chunky square pixel grid, one-native-pixel dark outline. Native rows 0 through 10 stay EMPTY because this elf has no hat. Head including hair and ears fits a 22x16 reference region, native rows11 through26. Upper body and tunic occupy rows27 through39 (13 pixels); knees and boots rows40 through46 (7 pixels); bottom row47 EMPTY. Slim standing waist at row35 is10 pixels wide, tunic hem rows37 through39 is10 to12 pixels wide. Foot contact at row46. Whole-body anatomy coherent. No tall body, no long legs. Braid can extend into torso as a hair attachment but ends above the tunic hem. Face and ear/hair boundary outline is continuous and only one native pixel thick. Two open pupils are equal 1x2 native-pixel vertical marks, separated from surrounding hair and face outlines by a complete one-native-pixel skin halo. Face gently looking toward the viewer's LEFT with both eyes visible, head centered over body.

Use EXACTLY FIVE FLAT COLORS: deep plum ink #241C32 for outline, eyes and boots; warm pale cream #F6D1AC for skin and collar; chestnut brown #916047 for ALL hair; sage green #718C59 for clothes and leaf accessory; light yellow-green #B5C77D for the leaf wrap and leaf clip highlight. No other colors, no gradients, no antialiasing, no dithering, no tiny decorations. Classic simple low-resolution game sprite, not a high-resolution pixel-style illustration. Preserve true transparency. The main result must be readable as a NEW elf from the braid, ears and leaf shoulder-wrap silhouette together.
